strategies.name: vwap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Use VWAP as a directional context filter: if you already have a long session bias, wait for price to extend away from VWAP to at least the first, ideally the second, standard-deviation band, then enter in the trend direction after price breaks back above that band and retests it.
strategies.exit_summary: Use the outer VWAP bands as profit targets, specifically the second and/or third standard deviation. The setup is invalid if price cannot reclaim and hold the band on the break-and-retest sequence.

strategies.name: vwap_band_reversion_to_mean
strategies.entry_summary: Trade reversals from stretched VWAP extremes: when price reaches outer VWAP standard-deviation bands in an overbought/oversold condition, look for a reversal entry from those extreme premium/discount levels.
strategies.exit_summary: Target a rebalance back to the central session VWAP as the mean-reversion objective.

consensus.enumeration_note: The video teaches two opposed executable uses of the same VWAP structure: trend continuation after reclaim/retest of a deviation band, and reversal/mean reversion from outer deviation bands back to VWAP.
